entities.name: Unified Access Control Barring Check Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for determining if a UE access attempt is barred based on access category, timers, and system information parameters.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer running for specific access categories that can cause access attempts to be barred.

entities.name: Timer T302
entities.description: General access barring timer that affects access attempts for categories other than 0 and 2.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Numerical identifier (0, 2, etc.) that determines access control treatment.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: System information block containing access control parameters including uac-BarringPerPLMN-List and uac-BarringForCommon.

entities.name: UAC-BarringPerPLMN
entities.description: PLMN-specific access barring parameters contained in SIB1.

entities.name: uac-BarringForCommon
entities.description: Common access barring parameters included in SIB1.

entities.name: UAC-BarringInfoSet
entities.description: Set of barring parameters used for access barring checks.

entities.name: Access Attempt Barred
entities.description: Condition where UE determines access attempt is not allowed based on timers or barring parameters.

entities.name: Access Attempt Allowed
entities.description: Condition where UE determines access attempt is permitted.

entities.name: Inform Upper Layers
entities.description: Action of notifying upper layers about access barring status (barred or allowed).

relations.description: Procedure checks if timer T390 is running for the access category to determine if access is barred.
Procedure checks if timer T302 is running to determine if access is barred for certain categories.
Procedure uses access category value to determine barring treatment.
Procedure uses parameters from SIB1 to determine access barring configuration.
SIB1 may contain UAC-BarringPerPLMN list for PLMN-specific barring parameters.
SIB1 may contain uac-BarringForCommon for common barring parameters.
When access is barred, UE informs upper layers about the barring status.
When access is allowed, UE informs upper layers about the allowed status.
Procedure uses UAC-BarringInfoSet for performing access barring checks.
